item.description:
If you know a loved one suffering from cancer or another long-term illness:
1. Upload all of the patient's medical records (e.g., to a Google Drive folder)
2. Tell ChatGPT or Claude to install my free /fuck-cancer skill (just point them at the link: https://t.co/4fi5N8hsSG)
3. Point the skill at the folder to create a one-page brief, research clinical trials, and more.
You're also welcome to fork the skill and modify it for other long-term conditions.
tl:dr Use the full power of AI to beat shitty diseases.

item.title: Nikunj Kothari (@nikunj): I thought after Llama 4 we had stopped benchmark-maxxing as a flex.. but it seems like the cartel is...
item.description:
I thought after Llama 4 we had stopped benchmark-maxxing as a flex.. but it seems like the cartel is back again.
There’s no substitute to really using the models for your workflows to understand the best ones that actually work for your workflows.
In reality, there’s only very very few benchmarks that truly matter, and the real ones know.
Rest is primarily posturing or hill climbing on one just to use as marketing (which in reality does work for a select group of companies but won’t last over time)
